# A clearer Dopsy interface

Dopsy v0.1.1 is a visual and documentation refresh for the first public
preview. It introduces no new Docker permissions and does not change the
read-only boundary.

## Highlights

- A cleaner diagnostic workspace with restrained forest-green accents and more
  room for the investigation itself.
- Clearer container navigation, investigation progress, and supporting
  evidence.
- A refined mark and wordmark used consistently across the app, documentation,
  favicons, and social preview.
- Updated setup, provider, demo, and security guidance.

## What remains the same

Dopsy still performs only bounded diagnostic reads through the companion proxy.
Authentication, historical metrics, multi-host operation, alerting, and
container modification are not part of this release.

## Try the local demo

```bash
git clone https://github.com/smn-pascal/dopsy.git
cd dopsy
cp .env.example .env
# Set DOPSY_DEMO_MODE=true in .env
docker compose up --build
```

Open `http://localhost:8080`. See the
[documentation](https://smn-pascal.github.io/dopsy/) for the security boundary
and provider configuration.
